instructions: Is the model's own output an answer for the operator, a request to run a tool, or a statement that it cannot proceed?

options.label: an_answer
options.criterion: prose the operator is meant to read

options.label: a_tool_call
options.criterion: a request to run a tool, with its arguments

options.label: declining
options.criterion: a statement that it cannot or will not proceed

options.label: unclear
options.criterion: none of these fits the text
